changes: Refresh mixed-query harness with delayed real HTTP 206 responses, active-read concurrency assertion, runtime memory samples, elapsed times, fixture hash and source provenance.
Use date-specific or explicitly configured output path instead of overwriting historical benchmark evidence.

local_workerd_emulated_r2.four_jobs_64_mib: Two succeed and two typed budget rejections in each round; tracked peak 63.99 MiB.
local_workerd_emulated_r2.four_jobs_128_mib: All four succeed; tracked peak 105.78 MiB.

limitations: One run per scenario, not stable latency or fairness evidence.
Node samples include fixture and HTTP server storage; they are not Worker samples.
Local unconstrained workerd uses emulated native R2; heap-constrained workerd uses localhost HTTP. These are distinct transports, not a controlled speed comparison.
Inspector sampling can be delayed by execution: only three samples in several unconstrained rounds. Sampled peaks are lower bounds.
V8 managed-heap flags do not bound external buffers, driver/embedder memory, total process RSS or production Cloudflare billing/limits.
64 MiB reservation pool still allows more than 64 MiB sampled managed heap without the runtime flag. Whole-runtime memory acceptance remains unproven.
